terms.gloss: durian: the tree and its fruit (the botanical name)
terms.comment: The botanists’ name, labelled modern: Durio is their Latin form of the Malay name, zibethīnus “of the civet”, for the smell. In speech Durio alone will do. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini) has a name for it.

phrases.latin: Durio foedē olet, sed suāviter sapit.
phrases.english: The durian smells awful, but it tastes lovely.
